description: The judge adjourns the case until a set time (10 minutes to 30 days ahead), with a reason: for example to let a side gather evidence, or to hear the case next week. Until then nothing proceeds except ordered evidence, settlement and exits; then the current stage resumes with its full time. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: adjourn
title: Adjourn the hearing
